title: Your Car Can Get BETTER Overnight. Here's How 📲⚡ #shorts

scenes.text: In twenty eighteen, a car got better brakes overnight, without ever visiting a shop.
Consumer Reports had flagged the Tesla Model 3's long stopping distance. A software update cut it by about twenty feet.
During Hurricane Irma, Tesla unlocked hidden battery capacity on some Florida cars. Sixty kilowatt-hours became seventy-five, about thirty extra miles.
It works because the car has its own internet connection, and downloads updates in the background.
The clever part: two copies of the software. The new version installs on the spare copy, and the car switches on restart. If it fails, it rolls back.
But the switch that unlocked those miles can lock them again. Who really owns your car's features? Follow EV Drive.
